section.content: 本发明公开了一种半导体集成电路。在装有PLL(Phase LockedLoop)电路的半导体集成电路中，有效地利用该PLL电路达到稳定振荡的时间。在实际工作准备期间，在将PLL电路50的反馈环路切断的状态下，将基准时钟100供给相位比较器51的参考时钟输入部Fr及反馈时钟输入部Fr这两个部，调整该相位比较器51内的复位信号的延迟，以便减小相位比较器51内的相位差检测死区。

During a period of preparation for actual operation, a reference clock is supplied to both a comparison clock input portion and a feedback clock input portion of a phase comparator while a feedback loop of a PLL (phase-locked loop) is interrupted, and a delay of a reset signal within the phase comparator is adjusted so as to reduce a detection dead zone of phase differences in the phase comparator.

Semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical background

The present invention relates to a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit that comprises clock generation circuit, particularly a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit of loading onto PLL (Phase Locked Loop) circuit.Background technology

In computer systems such as microprocessor, microcontroller, established a kind of PLL circuit that frequency multiplied clock produces the effect of circuit that plays, and, finally realized running up in the function that foreign frequency is doubled in the part realization of central processing unit.And, in the nearest microprocessor, also require the phase place of the clock in external bus and the semiconductor integrated circuit to keep very high precision.

Up to the present, such method is arranged, promptly with timer calculate plug in after, the PLL circuit reaches the stable time, to the some time, stops clock being fed to central processing unit from the PLL circuit, when timer overflows (overflow), begin to provide frequency multiplied clock again.

In the phase comparator of hope in the PLL circuit, keep a kind of linear relationship between the phase difference of two signals being imported and the output voltage.And in fact, can not detect small phase difference, there is phase difference dead band (dead zone) sometimes; Sometimes sensitivity is too high and have discontinuous point.

Know, the output of phase comparator go into characteristic be subjected to reset circuit time of delay length influence very big.In other words, characteristic is gone in the output that wants to improve phase comparator, just must make to reach time of delay of reset circuit a suitable value.Yet because in the related phase comparator of first prior art, reset circuit is made of one 4 input NAND circuit, and time of delay is just short than desired value, and output is gone into characteristic and had dead band (referring to Patent Document 1).

For being the time of delay that makes reset circuit that a desired value has carried out various improvement.Second prior art is such, narrow down by making the transistorized channel width that constitutes 4 input NAND circuits, and the output of delayed reset signal (referring to Patent Document 2).The 3rd prior art is such, used a plurality of capacitors to make the parts of the output of delayed reset signal (referring to Patent Document 3).

As mentioned above, in the related phase place comparator of first prior art, because reset circuit Consisted of by one 4 input NAND circuit, so time delay is shorter than desired value, the import and export characteristic On the dead band has been arranged. In the situation of second prior art, because transistorized grid width is at μ Below the m, so because the decline of the product percent of pass that the wide grade of raceway groove causes is inevitable. In the situation of three prior aries, capacitor can cause chip area to increase.

Also have, also there is the one side that makes the import and export characteristic degradation in the charge pump loop. When using the current mode electric charge In the situation on blowback road, although sometimes do not have phase difference between two signals, the output of phase place comparator Variation has but taken place in voltage. In other words, although input can detect mistakenly with the clock of phase place Go out phase difference, so that do not realize high-precision PLL circuit.

Also have, although during design clock driver, allow it can be with distortion (skew) 0 synchronous the time Clock is supplied with each functional block, but can be owing to deviations such as temperature, manufacturing process between each chip and Produce the distortion deviation.

Also have such design, in each functional block, use clock at dynamic loop, memory etc. In the circuit of synchronous two phase clock, for do not compete (racing) add in advance one postpone so that Work stablely. But the tolerance limit of two phase clock can reduce owing to the deviation of manufacturing process etc., and leads Cause maloperation.

Also have, when for realize that low power consumption processes when no longer needing in a series of operations, tool is arranged The functional block that makes the function that operation thereafter stops is arranged, but operation is owing to operating frequency, make the worker Skill deviation etc. and not exclusively stopping, the result produces maloperation.

And, for addressing these problems the adjustment circuit being set, the operation of adjustment circuit will be waited until after the PLL circuit is stablized and just start working, will be to waste of time.

Summary of the invention

Purpose of the present invention is: effectively utilize clock generation circuit clock signal of system that a period of time before is provided, particularly wait the PLL circuit to reach that stable a period of time.

For achieving the above object, the present invention is such, the semiconductor integrated circuit that comprises the clock generation circuit that produces clock signal of system from reference clock signal, before by clock generation circuit feed system clock signal, use reference clock signal to adjust the interior particular electrical circuit part of this semiconductor integrated circuit.Particularly in the semiconductor integrated circuit that the PLL circuit is housed, before this PLL circuit stable oscillation stationary vibration, use reference clock signal to adjust the particular electrical circuit part.

Particularly, under the state that the feedback control loop with the PLL circuit cuts off, reference clock signal is fed to reference clock input part and these two portions of feedback clock input part of phase comparator, adjust the delay of the reset signal in this phase comparator, so that reduce the phase difference detection dead band of phase comparator.

Under situation in order to the band-gap reference circuit that reference voltage fed to the current-type charge pump circuit in the PLL circuit, under the state that the feedback control loop with the PLL circuit cuts off, reference clock signal one of is fed in the reference clock input part of the phase comparator in this PLL circuit and the feedback clock input part, adjust the phase compensation amount of this band-gap reference circuit, so that band-gap reference circuit does not vibrate.

Under the situation of the current-type charge pump circuit in the PLL circuit, under the state that the feedback control loop with the PLL circuit cuts off, reference clock signal one of is fed in the reference clock input part of the phase comparator in this PLL circuit and the feedback clock input part, adjust the current driving ability of current-type charge pump circuit.

Under situation, adjust distortion (skew) between a plurality of clock drivers in this clock distribution circuit to reduce the output clock distortion of this clock distribution circuit in order to the clock distribution circuit of clock signal of system being distributed to a plurality of functional blocks.

Under the situation of the such data holding circuit of synchronousing working of the dynamic circuit more than 2 sections of the memory circuit that comprises word line and sensor amplifier, serial connection, in the internal work of this data holding circuit, adjust competition with clock signal of system.

Under the situation of the such functional circuit of speed buffering circuit with the effect that reduces power consumption, in the time of during the feedback clock signal according to reference clock signal and PLL circuit detects the frequency that enters this PLL circuit to introduce phase place inching after being over, just allow a part in the functional circuit quit work according to the frequency adjustment of the oscillating clock signal of PLL circuit.
